insights.summary: The second steering committee reviewed the retention pilot results and decided whether to go live. After three weeks, the save rate on contacted customers was 31% against a 25% target. Churn was 1.9% in the test group versus 3.4% in the control group, and each saved customer cost about 38 euros, mostly the free month of subscription. The CFO said this cost was well below the cost of acquiring a new customer. Because of the IT summer production freeze, the committee approved going live for all Essentielle customers on September 15th, and Customer Operations raised a concern about agent staffing during August.

decisions.decision: Go live for all Essentielle customers on September 15th (2026-09-15).
Approved the September 15th go-live while respecting the summer production freeze from July 25th to August 20th.

action_items.task: Prepare the go-live communication plan for the agents and management.

risks: Staffing: many agents are on holiday in August, so the ramp-up before go-live will be tight (raised by Claire Dubois).
No production changes are allowed during the summer freeze (July 25th to August 20th), which delays industrialisation of the pilot.
